tools.name: get_advisory
tools.description:
Get a security advisory (vulnerability) by its key.

Returns a security advisory by key — e.g. a GHSA id taken from a version's advisoryKeys — including the title, CVE aliases, CVSS v3 score and vector, and a link to the full record on osv.dev. Use this only when you already have an advisory ID from

tools.name: get_dependencies
tools.description:
Get the resolved dependency graph for one package version.

Returns the full resolved dependency graph (direct and indirect) for a version — each node has the dependency's exact version and its relation (SELF / DIRECT / INDIRECT). Use it to reason about transitive dependencies and supply chain.

tools.name: get_package
tools.description:
List every version of a package and whether each is deprecated.

Returns all published versions of a package with publish date, the default-version flag, and deprecation status. Use it to find the latest version or check if a package is deprecated. Coding agents should call this before recommending

tools.name: get_package_version
tools.description:
Get license, security advisories, and source links for one package version.

Returns detailed metadata for a single version: SPDX licenses, security advisoryKeys (known vulnerabilities), homepage/issue-tracker/source-repo links, registries, publish date, and deprecation status. Pass any advisoryKey

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "dependency-trust-f1aaf06d" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_package_version, get_project_health · Private data: get_advisory, get_project_health · Public sink: get_package, get_package_version.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_package_version, get_project_health · Private data: get_advisory, get_project_health · Public sink: get_package, get_package_version

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
